videos.title: Venezuela Earthquakes Leave Families Waiting for News on Missing
videos.hook: Twin earthquakes have flattened parts of Venezuela, leaving residents without news of loved ones and testing the country's capacity to deliver emergency aid.

videos.title: Oil Prices Rise After U.S.-Iran Talks Collapse
videos.hook: Breakdown in U.S.-Iran talks is pushing oil prices higher, raising costs for drivers and heating bills worldwide while clouding prospects for regional stability.
